arguments.sql: SELECT c.card_brand, 1.0 * SUM(f.is_fraud) / COUNT(*) AS fraud_rate, COUNT(*) AS labelled_transactions, SUM(f.is_fraud) AS fraud_count FROM transactions t JOIN fraud_labels f ON f.transaction_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT) JOIN cards c ON c.id = t.card_id GROUP BY c.card_brand ORDER BY c.card_brand
arguments.explanation: Computes the fraud rate for each card brand over labelled transactions, with counts for context.
assumptions: Fraud rate is computed over labelled transactions only; unlabelled transactions are excluded.
Brands are grouped as recorded in cards.card_brand (Amex, Discover, Mastercard, Visa).
